first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: In frame 0 of this clip, Person A is in the left foreground. The person has short dark hair, wears a blue-gray top with rolled-up sleeves and tan-brown trousers, and has brown crossed shoulder straps; track this person by clothing and continuous action, and the position may change with the camera.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The other person who continuously interacts with Person A in this clip. The person has relatively short gray-brown hair and wears a dark crew-neck short-sleeved top and dark trousers; this person does not have Person A's crossed shoulder straps and continuously interacts with Person A while holding a sword.

entities.name: Sword A
entities.identification: The sword held by Person A, identified by its held relationship with Person A and by continuous action; a long curved blade and a metal guard near the hand are visible.

entities.name: Sword B
entities.identification: The sword held by Person B, identified by its held relationship with Person B and by continuous action; do not switch its designation based on whether it is at the top or bottom of the image or based on momentary reflections.

entities.name: Wooden Plank Floor
entities.identification: The continuous wooden-plank surface beneath the persons' feet and between the two persons, with seams between the planks extending into the distance; it does not include the stairs above, the Pillar, or the scattered metal objects.

entities.name: Metal Debris on the Ground
entities.identification: The collection of disc-shaped and irregular small metal objects scattered and piled on the Wooden Plank Floor; do not number them individually, and do not include Sparks from Clashing Swords in the air.

entities.name: Pillar
entities.identification: A thick upright columnar structural element indoors, visible at the side and in the background; it is defined separately from the slender, closely spaced bars of the Grating.

entities.name: Background Wall Rack
entities.identification: The background structure composed of large dark wall surfaces, frame edges, and elevated beam racks behind the persons, excluding the separately defined Pillar, Grating, Background Stairs, and Box.

entities.name: Background Stairs
entities.identification: The stairs in the background composed of several horizontal steps that rise progressively, located behind the persons and not including ordinary seams between floorboards.

entities.name: Box
entities.identification: The collection of low rectangular box-like containers in the background, with square frames, metal edges, and open or tilted lid surfaces visible; count only the areas visible in this clip.

entities.name: Flames
entities.identification: Orange-yellow tongues of fire visible near the Pillar, wall rack, and background edges; this does not include the white flashes and brief sparks that appear when the swords meet.

entities.name: Sparks from Clashing Swords
entities.identification: Bright specks and short streaks that scatter briefly near where the two swords meet, appearing and dissipating with the sword-clashing action; this does not include stationary Metal Debris on the Ground or ambient Flames.
